question: Why was the distinction of purity and impurity concealed by the sages?
premises: The sages concealed that principle for the protection of the world.
Purity and impurity may appear in external things.
They are not objective properties of things like the color blue.
inference: The sages concealed the deeper principle because purity and impurity are not inherent in external objects but depend on another basis.
uncertainties: The referent of tattattva may be the ultimate principle or the specific teaching about purity.
plain_english: For the protection of the world, the sages carefully concealed that principle. Even when purity and impurity seem to appear in external things, they are not fixed properties of those things like blueness is.
